tool_args.rationale: The five pilot rows cannot reliably identify the sink-gradient coefficient. The discriminating probe supplies wide s_grad leverage and can distinguish the open branch before fitting across the full fallback parameter range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the siphon square-root branch using pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho nearly collinear, leaving the gradient effect poorly identified.
The open-branch probe directly supplies the needed wide-gradient leverage at lower cost.
It does not resolve the identified mechanism ambiguity.
